system.description:
Touch; casting takes 10 minutes. You inscribe a 10ft-diameter circle linked to one other Teleportation Circle you know. When a command word you choose is spoken, up to 8 creatures standing within it are transported to the linked circle (once per hour). Permanent until dispelled. No save. Material: amber dust worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard
